allocation.rule: At each look, distribute each arm as evenly as integer arithmetic permits across opponent x seat strata.
allocation.runtime_priority: Prefer the arm with fewer scored games, then the most underfilled target stratum; if the highest-priority opponent/seat is unavailable, use the next available underfilled target.
allocation.extra_nonprimary_opponents: May be recorded diagnostically but are not substituted silently for missing primary quotas in the primary named-opponent gate.
